cases.name: extension_load

assertions.expected: Pi loads the package extension and emits its handled prompt response
assertions.observed: template extension status and handled response are present

cases.name: happy_path

assertions.expected: The template command is handled without an LLM request

cases.name: error_path

assertions.expected: Malformed RPC input is reported as a parse error without an unhandled exception
assertions.observed: parse failure is reported and the process exits cleanly

cases.name: reload_cleanup

assertions.expected: A second isolated Pi process can load and shut down the extension cleanly
assertions.observed: process exits cleanly with no shutdown error

assertions.expected: The host shell is the pinned Pi 1.1.0 runtime
